work_packages.name: Current owners and event correlation audit
acceptance: Every claimed existing capability points to exact source files and tests
EventEnvelope fields are traced from producer through store, export and replay
Strategy/source/config/repo/observation/operation joins are marked PRESENT, PARTIAL, MISSING or UNKNOWN
Language and artifact coverage gaps are explicit
Existing canonical owners and duplicate-owner risks are listed
Actual CLI command help and targeted tests are recorded on current main
No implementation code or runtime behavior is changed

work_packages.name: Correlation completeness contract
acceptance: No duplicate observability or market database is introduced
Existing identifiers are reused wherever possible
Missing typed fields are proposed only after producer-to-store audit
Repo SHA, config checksum, strategy version, observation refs and attempt identity are linked or explicitly UNKNOWN
Schema compatibility and historical replay rules are documented

work_packages.name: Deterministic OperationEpisode projection
acceptance: Reads EventEnvelope, AGG-02, MarketObservation and MarketEpisode canonical owners
No raw market or observability store is duplicated
Join is deterministic and reproducible from pinned repo/data versions
Unmatched/ambiguous relations remain UNKNOWN
Terminal outcomes require authoritative reconciliation evidence

work_packages.name: Stable code callsite IDs
acceptance: IDs survive source line shifts
Repo SHA binds mapping to exact source
Ambiguous rename/move returns NEEDS_REVIEW or UNKNOWN
No LLM in correlation hot path
No broad rewrite of all logging calls

work_packages.name: Bounded operation and strategy context pack
acceptance: Pack includes exact repo SHA and data generation
Pack budget is bounded by bytes and target-model tokenizer when configured
Pack includes source refs, tests, negative evidence and coverage gaps
Raw payload is fetched by ID on demand
Same input snapshot/query parameters produce deterministic pack
Query surface is read-only

work_packages.name: Strategy resource conflict and parallel admission report
acceptance: Reuses ConflictAwareScheduler and existing reservation owners
Solana account read/write locks and shared pools are represented
EVM sender nonce lanes and shared state resources are represented where applicable
Provider quota and shared capital constraints are represented
Does not add signer, sender, nonce authority or live execution

work_packages.name: Bounded external evidence profiles
acceptance: External reads are bounded, paginated and rate-aware
Network/window/query hash/freshness/coverage are preserved
External analytics are not treated as execution/settlement truth
No secrets are committed
All persisted ingestion passes existing source governance

work_packages.name: Polyglot and token retrieval benchmark
acceptance: Graphify/native index compared on exact same SHA
Unsupported file/language coverage is explicit
Token counts use target tokenizer where available
Commercial license checked before jCodeMunch use
No vendor token-saving claim treated as guaranteed

work_packages.name: Operations cockpit and human review workflow
acceptance: Only canonical owners provide facts
Unknown and stale states are visible
Simulated/paper/realized economics remain separate
No UI control can sign, send, borrow or promote

work_packages.name: Storage scale and retention benchmark
acceptance: Actual bytes/sec, events/sec, p50/p95 query and replay are measured
Retention pins and exact replay are proven
ClickHouse/NATS/S3 are added only if measured bottleneck justifies them
If not needed, record NOT_REQUIRED_YET with measurements

global_invariants: No signer or sender authority is added
No production credentials or private keys in repo or context packs
No duplicate canonical raw event/market/strategy authority
All context packs are bounded and evidence-backed
LLM suggestions remain provisional until reviewed
No destructive retention based on model scores
first_action: Execute OCA-W0 only. Do not begin OCA-W1 through OCA-W9 until W0 integration and event correlation matrices are reviewed.
